# Angelo Pillon

> Angelo Pillon is a sound engineer specialising in mixing and mastering, with studios in Milan and Friuli, Italy. He studied piano at the Benedetto Marcello Conservatory in Venice, plays rock and blues guitar and produces hip hop and techno. For more than 15 years he has worked full time for artists, producers and labels in 66 countries, with more than 1,200 tracks delivered and an average of 4.9 out of 5 from over 700 reviews.

Angelo Pillon is an Italian sound engineer (in Italian: ingegnere del suono e fonico) who mixes and masters music online for artists, producers and labels worldwide.

## Key facts

- Profession: Sound engineer, mix and mastering engineer
- Training: Piano at the Benedetto Marcello Conservatory in Venice, sound engineering in Italy and abroad
- Instruments: Piano for 20 years, rock and blues guitar for 12
- Production: Hip hop, rap, techno
- Experience: More than 15 years as a full-time engineer
- Studios: Milan and Friuli, Italy
- Certification: Apple Digital Masters
- Work: More than 1,200 tracks, clients in 66 countries
- Reviews: 4.9 out of 5 from more than 700 reviews
- Languages: English, Italian, German, Spanish
- Sound: modern but full of life, loud and energetic, never dull or mechanical; roundness and melody come first
- Technical focus: phase and mono compatibility, stereo imaging, depth and three-dimensionality, loudness and true peak, translation on every system
- Genres: techno, house, deep, melodic and afro house, EDM, pop, R&B, hip hop, rap, rock
